team_executable_actions.rationale: Close every operator leaf against the immutable semantic identity before connecting a Transformer layer.

team_executable_actions.on_failure: Remain at the single-layer gate and invoke contract-guided localization. Do not proceed to multi-layer or board-wrapper generation. Reopen a passed leaf only if the single-layer boundary trace identifies a contradictory earliest leaf boundary.
team_executable_actions.rationale: Promote only from a current-valid operator-leaf certificate and prove connected stream, order, liveness, numeric, and weight semantics for one Transformer layer.

team_executable_actions.on_failure: Keep multilayer generation and functional simulation blocked. If the evidence yields multiple plausible wrappers, source sets, clocks, or interfaces, issue a bounded approval request with cited alternatives rather than guessing or substituting a simplified wrapper.
team_executable_actions.rationale: Bind the third layer to the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper, simulation sources, clock, ports, AXI/DDR interfaces, and source hashes without hardcoded framework-core target names.

team_executable_actions.on_failure: Block case_vivado_synthesis. Localize the earliest liveness, value, order, transfer, protocol, address, weight-consumption, wrapper, or runtime-memory violation and enter the bounded repair action at the third layer. Do not modify the checkpoint, stimulus, reference, tolerance, semantic testbench, or exact wrapper source hashes.
team_executable_actions.rationale: Close all third-layer functional subgates with the exact sample wrapper and immutable semantic identity before any Vivado synthesis request.

team_executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the failed layer and every downstream node blocked. On retry-budget exhaustion, missing verifier capability, or a proposed architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy, or major-template change, stop automatic repair and emit the appropriate scoped backtrack or approval request. Never alter golden output or tolerance inside the repair loop.
team_executable_actions.rationale: Drive each failed layer through tool-output localization, compact causal context, bounded template-constrained repair, and targeted rerun while preventing repair spin and unsupported lower-layer reopening.

team_executable_actions.on_failure: Reject backend release and rerun the earliest certificate producer whose evidence is absent, stale, untrusted, mismatched, or not current-contract-valid. Do not waive a third-layer subgate or synthesize from a stale certificate.
team_executable_actions.rationale: Validate all promotion certificates against the current contract and release only a hash-bound board-functional closure manifest to backend planning, without claiming synthesis or runtime.

team_executable_actions.on_failure: Do not generate a bitstream. Preserve the functional identity bundle and exact wrapper hashes, classify the earliest synthesis, DRC, timing, packaging, or integration failure, and route a bounded backend repair; if real evidence contradicts functional closure, create a trace-supported Stage7 backtrack.
team_executable_actions.rationale: Keep synthesis and implementation strictly downstream of the current-valid board AXI/DDR functional certificate and exact sample-project source identity.

team_executable_actions.on_failure: Do not claim bitstream or board-runtime pass. If target discovery remains ambiguous, stop before target execution and issue a bounded approval request with cited candidates; otherwise route the first failed bitstream, ABI, deployment, or output checker to bounded backend recovery without changing the verification golden or tolerance.
team_executable_actions.rationale: Use user materials and real Vivado evidence to select the app-shell target, then generate the bitstream and execute board runtime only after implementation and ABI checks pass.

backtrack_contract.required_action: Record a SACG backtrack_request with the missing contract/tool/evidence facts or the explicit contradicted lower-layer gate/module. Rerun only the challenged lower-layer scope when the trace is bound; otherwise rerun the failed current-layer trace first. Stage7 or later stages may retry only after the repaired lower/current layer revalidates.

instrumentation_contract.resource_policy: Boundary monitors are verification instrumentation and should be generated by the case adapter or testbench path. Persistent hardware monitors require explicit runtime/debug approval because they may consume FPGA resources.

repair_handoff_contract.layer_rule: If all lower debug layers have passing evidence and the current merged layer fails, the next action is current-layer boundary tracing or targeted replay over the integration path. Lower-layer pass evidence is reusable, not absolute; reopen a lower layer only when the new boundary trace explicitly contradicts its pass evidence.
repair_handoff_contract.repair_rule: Repair agents must patch the localized causal slice or request targeted replay; they must not patch the downstream symptom module solely because it observed the failure.
